SELECT count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT e.exposure_id) AS exp_ids, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT e.member_key) AS keys,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.delivered THEN m.member_id END) AS delivered_members,
 min(contact_ts_utc) AS mn, max(contact_ts_utc) AS mx,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.member_id END) AS in_holdout,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT m.marketing_consent THEN m.member_id END) AS no_consent_members,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.member_key IS NULL) AS orphan_rows
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
LEFT JOIN campaign_holdout h ON h.campaign_id = e.campaign_id AND h.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE e.campaign_id = 19

SELECT 'stg' AS src, count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT exposure_id) AS ids, min(contact_ts_utc) AS mn, max(contact_ts_utc) AS mx, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys FROM stg_campaign_contact_load WHERE campaign_id = 19

WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19)

 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) AS holdout_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM t JOIN campaign_holdout h ON h.member_id=t.member_id AND h.campaign_id=19) AS overlap,

calls.statement:
WITH targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, m.member_id, f.net_amount, s.store_id, p.category,
         COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS recog_date, f.sale_date, w.status AS web_status, f.etl_loaded_at
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
  WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM targeted))
SELECT 'all lines in window by recog date' AS what, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS rl, round(sum(net_amount),2) AS net, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS mem
FROM lines WHERE recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'excl 999/ZZ', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)), round(sum(net_amount),2), count(DISTINCT member_id)
FROM lines WHERE recog_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND store_id <> 999 AND category <> 'ZZ Test'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'excl 999/ZZ, by sale_date', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)), round(sum(net_amount),2), count(DISTINCT member_id)
FROM lines WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24' AND store_id <> 999 AND category <> 'ZZ Test'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web lines excl: status ' || coalesce(web_status,'none') || ' store ' || store_id, count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), 0, round(sum(net_amount),2), 0
FROM lines WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-05-31' AND store_id = 900 GROUP BY web_status, store_id

WITH targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted) AS members_contacted,
       ROUND(SUM(ms.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales_eur_excl_vat_before_returns
FROM targeted t
JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = t.member_id
